## Problem and proposed change

Who benefits and what problem does this solve?

## Evidence and scope

For a source, include its public URL, maintainer, license/terms, update frequency, proposed profile, known overlap and false-positive risk. Explain what you tested.

## Alternatives

Describe alternatives or compatibility concerns. Do not include private browsing data.
